items.title: Claude Developer Platform release notes: 2026-11-17
items.snippet: We’ve launched Linked billing in beta with the user-profiles-billing-2026-10-01 beta header. Your customers can now pay for the Claude usage in your app through their own Claude organization. Once a customer links their organization, set billing_policy on each /v1/messages or /v1/chat/completions request to choose who pays. In the Claude Console, customers can set a spend cap for your app or unlink your app. Linked billing works for customers whose organization pays Anthropic directly for API usage.

items.title: Claude apps release notes: 2026-11-17
items.snippet: Choose a release channel in Claude Desktop · You can now use a release channel to set which version of Claude Desktop you get when the app updates. Stable stays the default and gets new versions less often, after more testing. Latest gets a new version about once a day, so fixes and new features reach you sooner. For more information, see Choose a release channel .

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.327 → 2.1.327
items.snippet:
2.1.327
- Added a confirmation before `/install-github-app` changes a repository
- Added `claude mcp add-json <name> -` to read the server's JSON from stdin, so tokens can stay off the command line; not available inside a Claude Code session
- Added a line when a resumed session's earlier messages can't be loaded
- Added a list in `/status` of broken agent, skill, command and output style files, keybinding errors, an unavailable sandbox, ignored permission settings and hook matchers that never match
- Added a note in `/config` when other settings override a row
- Added `x-claude-code-managed-settings-checksum` to the gateway hint headers; sent where managed settings set `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1`, including where they already do
- Added support for naming a session's billing group with the `attributionProject` setting, for Claude apps gateways that set `admin.billing_group_tag`
- Added `/tui classic` as the name for the non-fullscreen renderer; `/tui default` still works
